summary: Frontend testing of Settings page and Change Log page features. All 14 requested features verified working as expected. Settings persist in localStorage; toggle, duration selector, reset all work; Change Log view modes (Live/Daily/Weekly/Monthly), date navigation, Print (opens print window), Export (downloads CSV) all functional. User menu shows Settings and Change Log links. Dashboard still shows Live indicator.

integration_issues.issue: WebSocket connection fails in preview environment (wss://.../api/ws) - 'WebSocket is closed before connection is established'. This may impact the 'Live' view mode in Change Log and real-time toast updates. The Settings page Connection Status card hardcodes 'Connected - Live updates active' regardless of actual WebSocket state.

issues: Date selector uses native browser input[type=date] instead of shadcn Calendar/Popover component (inconsistent with shadcn UI pattern in the rest of the app).
Connection Status card shows a hardcoded green 'Connected - Live updates active' without reading actual WebSocket connection state from WebSocketContext. Should reflect real connection status.

action_items: (Minor) Wire SettingsPage 'Connection Status' indicator to actual WebSocket connection state from WebSocketContext instead of hardcoding 'Connected'.
(Optional) Consider replacing native date picker on Change Log with shadcn Calendar component for consistency.
Investigate WebSocket failure in preview environment if Live mode is expected to work end-to-end (may be infra-related, not code).
critical_code_review_comments: SettingsPage Connection Status is static UI - it does not actually reflect WebSocket connectivity. Misleading to users.
ChangeLogPage handlePrint uses window.open + document.write which can be blocked by popup blockers; consider using a hidden iframe or react-to-print library.

ChangeLogPage fetchChanges only queries the /staffing endpoint for change history; overtime/personnel/volunteer/parttime changes will NOT appear in Daily/Weekly/Monthly views (only in Live mode via realtime updates). The 'Overtime Changes' summary stat will always be 0 for non-live views.
ChangeLogPage formatChangeDetails handles personnel_name/apparatus_name but the underlying staffing change_history payload structure is not verified - may render 'undefined' for some change events.
Reset to Defaults calls removeItem then immediately re-saves DEFAULT_SETTINGS via useEffect - removeItem is redundant.
ChangeLogPage CSV export does not escape commas/newlines inside fields like change.modified_by which could break CSV parsing if names contain special chars.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Settings + Change Log features fully verified on frontend. WebSocket fails to connect in preview env (wss handshake closes early) - this is a pre-existing condition impacting Live view and real-time toasts; check whether ingress routes /api/ws upgrade headers properly. Settings localStorage key is 'userSettings'. Print opens a new tab via window.open; Export triggers a CSV download named change_log_{viewMode}_{date}.csv. Daily/Weekly/Monthly views only pull from /api/staffing change_history (no overtime/personnel/volunteer history aggregation).
rca of the issue: No blocking issues. Minor: SettingsPage Connection Status indicator is hardcoded, not bound to WebSocket state. WebSocket connection warning in console is environmental (preview infra), not a code regression.
